usage.outputShape: body.audio_url (signed CloudConvert MP3 URL, ~24h validity); also body.file_size_bytes, body.bitrate, body.content_type, body.source_url, body.job_id
quirks: inputSchema was null in the registry batch file; the real schema is embedded in the x402 payment-required header under extensions.bazaar.info (body {video_url required, bitrate enum [96,128,192]})
Response includes a job_id field but the call is fully synchronous — audio_url is returned directly in the 200 body, do NOT poll
video_url must be a PUBLIC, directly-downloadable video URL; max 500MB / 60 minutes
audio_url is a signed CloudConvert S3 URL that expires (~24h) — download/re-host promptly
Accepts any common video format (mov, webm, mkv, avi, m4v, flv) not just mp4
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {video_url, bitrate} to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/mp4-to-mp3 paying $0.10 USDC via x402 on Base. video_url must be a public direct-download video link (any common format, max 500MB/60min); bitrate is optional and must be one of 96, 128 (default), or 192 kbps. The 200 response returns the extracted MP3 at body.audio_url synchronously (ignore the job_id field, no polling needed). Download body.audio_url promptly since it is a signed CloudConvert URL that expires in ~24h.
